full_judgment:
4. The learned trial court held that the defendant could not prove the 'Estee'. The trial court also found that defendant could not prove patta settlement of the defendant No. 1 from the landlord. Moreover, the learned trial court did not believe the evidence of the D.Ws. It also held that the defendant could not prove their possession. The learned trial court believed that Gayesuddin's interest remained unaffected and plaintiff's title is clear, legal and valid. So the learned trial court decreed the suit on contest. 

 5. On appeal the learned lower appellate court, on the other hand, disbelieved the wit-nesses of the plaintiff. It also held that the defendant proved "'Istafa" successfully the learned lower appellate court also held that the defendants proved pattani settlement of the defendant No. 1 from the landlord. It also held that the defendant proved their possession over their suit land clearly. So the learned lower appellate court allowed the appeal on contest with cost. It also set aside the judgment and decree of the learned trial court. Against the judgment and decree the plaintiff preferred this second appeal in this court.
